config.tooltipeta.title: TooltipETA Configuration
config.tooltipeta.option.general.enabled: Turns the entire mod on or off.
config.tooltipeta.option.general.outputM: Detailed shows labels and extra lines, Compact keeps it short.
config.tooltipeta.option.features.showTo: Adds estimated uses for non-armor damageable items.
config.tooltipeta.option.features.showAr: Adds estimated uses for armor pieces.
config.tooltipeta.option.features.showEl: Adds estimated remaining flight time for Elytra.
config.tooltipeta.option.features.showLo: Shows an actionbar ETA while a thrown Loyalty trident is returning.
config.tooltipeta.option.display.showDur: Shows remaining durability as current / max (Detailed mode only).
config.tooltipeta.option.display.showPer: Shows remaining durability as a percentage (Detailed mode only).
config.tooltipeta.option.display.showBla: Inserts an empty line before TooltipETA output.
config.tooltipeta.option.thresholds.warn: At or below this value, estimate color becomes yellow.
config.tooltipeta.option.thresholds.crit: At or below this value, estimate color becomes red.
config.tooltipeta.option.whitelist.enabl: When enabled, TooltipETA only appears for listed item IDs.
config.tooltipeta.option.whitelist.itemI: Add full IDs like minecraft:diamond_pickaxe or minecraft:elytra.
